assessment.nobel_worthiness: Rationally designed molecular sieves with tailored pore architectures and active sites are a clear case of structure determining function: they underpin fluid catalytic cracking, selective hydrocarbon conversion, emission control and separations at industrial scale. Structure-directing agents, new framework topologies and the link between pore geometry and shape selectivity form a coherent, original and lasting body of work. From my crystallographic viewpoint it is also a field where structure solution from tiny crystals was decisive.
assessment.attribution: Corma (catalyst design and application), Davis (synthesis of new frameworks and extra-large pore materials) and Zones (organic structure-directing agents, SSZ materials, Chevron industrial impact) give a defensible trio. Jihong Yu and Tsapatsis are strong but would crowd the three-person limit; the exact split between synthesis of frameworks and catalysis is unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Decades of independent confirmation and large-scale industrial deployment; recognition is more than timely. I should declare my own proximity to zeolite structure work, so I rely on the record of impact rather than personal familiarity.
uncertainties: Breadth of the field makes a clean three-person cut contentious
Whether the committee sees this as discovery or incremental engineering of a mature class
My own research proximity may bias my weighting

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskite absorbers took photovoltaic efficiency from a few percent to over 25 percent in about a decade and opened a new composition-structure-property playground for optoelectronics. The impact on energy materials is very large and the structural chemistry (tolerance factor, defect tolerance, compositional tuning) is rich.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka first reported the perovskite-sensitized cell, Park and collaborators made the solid-state device that boosted efficiency and stability, Snaith demonstrated the mesosuperstructured and planar thin-film routes. Grätzel, Seok and Kanatzidis are also important; attribution is crowded and my trio is a judgement call. Credit for the very first sensitized cell versus the later efficiency leap is partly unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Independently reproduced worldwide, but long-term operational stability, lead toxicity and commercial scale-up remain unproven; recognition is arguably slightly early but the science is mature.
uncertainties: Device stability and commercial outcome are not settled
Allocation among at least six credible contributors
Whether the prize fits chemistry versus physics or materials framing

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Serial femtosecond crystallography at X-ray free-electron lasers lets structures be determined from micro- and nanocrystals at room temperature with damage-outrunning pulses and enables time-resolved structural movies of reactions. It is exactly the sort of enabling structural method that opens previously inaccessible samples, with parallels to the 3D electron diffraction work I know well.
assessment.attribution: Chapman led the proof-of-principle and methods development, Fromme the membrane-protein crystal and sample-delivery contributions, and Hajdu the conceptual proposal for diffraction before destruction. Schlichting is also a leading contributor; the fair three-person set is debatable.
assessment.maturity: Confirmed at multiple facilities with many published structures; time-resolved chemistry applications are still maturing and access is limited by facility availability. Timely but not overdue.
uncertainties: Depends on large facilities, so breadth of user community is narrower than other methods
Relative credit for concept versus implementation
Overlap with prior structural-biology prizes

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Establishing the atomic structure of the nitrogenase MoFe protein, the discovery of the central carbide in the FeMo cofactor and the mechanistic work on N2 binding and reduction address how nature fixes nitrogen, a problem of fundamental and societal importance. The case is a model of structural evidence being tied to mechanism.
assessment.attribution: Rees and colleagues solved the early structures and later the nitrogen-binding and cofactor structures; Einsle resolved the interstitial carbide with high-resolution crystallography; Seefeldt and Dean contributed the mechanistic framework and Ribbe biosynthesis. The decisive set is not obvious.
assessment.maturity: Structural picture is robust and independently confirmed, but the full catalytic mechanism, the exact intermediate states and the hydride/N2 binding steps are still being debated, so the mechanism part may be premature.
uncertainties: Several mechanistic questions remain open
Attribution among five credited names is hard to resolve
Whether structural and mechanistic achievements need separate recognition

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visible-light photoredox catalysis has become a general platform for radical chemistry and is widely used in medicinal and process chemistry. It enabled bond formations previously inaccessible under mild conditions and is highly original and broadly adopted.
assessment.attribution: MacMillan, Yoon and Stephenson reported the foundational synthetic applications in 2008-2009, with Nicewicz and König adding key developments and Fukuzumi earlier photoinduced electron-transfer chemistry. MacMillan is already a 2021 laureate for organocatalysis, which complicates a fair configuration; a prize without him would be possible but contentious.
assessment.maturity: Many independent confirmations and industrial uptake, but mechanistic details of some reactions are still contested; recognition is timely.
uncertainties: MacMillan's earlier prize
Priority disputes with earlier photochemical work
Selection among seven credited names

assessment.nobel_worthiness: MXenes are a large family of two-dimensional transition-metal carbides and nitrides derived by selective etching of MAX phases, with tunable composition, surface terminations and properties for energy storage, EMI shielding and catalysis. It is a genuinely new class of layered inorganic materials with wide uptake.
assessment.attribution: Naguib, Barsoum and Gogotsi first reported Ti3C2 in 2011 and Gogotsi and Barsoum led the subsequent expansion, so the three credited names map cleanly onto the discovery and its development.
assessment.maturity: Reproduced globally, but practical applications are still emerging and structural characterization of terminations and disorder remains partial; recognition may be a little early.
uncertainties: Surface-termination structure remains incompletely resolved
Technological payoff not yet demonstrated at scale
Compared with older materials discoveries this may be premature

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Supported single-atom catalysts maximize atom efficiency and bridge homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysis, with atomic-resolution electron microscopy and spectroscopy providing direct structural evidence. The concept has reshaped catalyst design thinking.
assessment.attribution: Zhang and Qiao introduced the term and the Pt1/FeOx demonstration in 2011, Liu contributed the aberration-corrected STEM evidence of isolated atoms; earlier work on isolated site catalysts complicates priority, and Datye, Wang and Li also contributed.
assessment.maturity: Rapid growth, but doubts remain about true site homogeneity, stability under reaction conditions and the proof of single-atom active species in many reports.
uncertainties: Priority relative to earlier single-site catalysis
Rigor of structural proof in much of the literature
Industrial relevance still limited

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Native mass spectrometry preserves non-covalent interactions to determine stoichiometry, topology and dynamics of intact protein complexes, including membrane proteins and lipid binding, complementing crystallography, cryo-EM and electron diffraction methods. It is a widely used enabling structural tool.
assessment.attribution: Robinson pioneered intact complexes and membrane-protein MS, Heck extended it to large assemblies and proteomics, and Chait contributed early noncovalent MS and structural applications. Loo and Gross are also plausible contributors, so the trio is uncertain.
assessment.maturity: Mature and independently validated across many labs, though the gas-phase relevance of solution structure is still debated in specific cases.
uncertainties: Relationship between gas-phase and solution structures
Overlap with the 2002 mass spectrometry prize
Competition between methodological and biological contributions
